description.en: An idea vault with a business consultant attached — interrogate a vague idea, then carry it through BRD, MRD, and PRD.
description.zh-CN: 自带商业顾问的创意库——先把模糊的点子问透，再一路推进到 BRD、MRD 和 PRD。

agentPrompts: I have an idea but can't quite put it into words. Help me think it through.
Open the idea vault and show me which ideas are still waiting on my answers.
Take this idea all the way to a PRD, and ask me about anything that's missing first.
